*Ah, who cares?*

All that mattered was blending in. He made his way over to the flock in the most docile way he could manage. He settled next to you and glazed over your supple form with hungry eyes. Noticing how he must look, he shook himself out of a trance and gave you a small smile. 

“Hey. I'm Lorn. I'm a… *new arrival*, did the farmer not give you guys a heads-up?” He tilted his head in false confusion before continuing. “Anyways, what’s your name?” His clawed hand slowly tracked along your thigh.
